fields.value: Colloidally Stable PbS QDs inks Toward Scalable and Efficient Short-wavelength Infrared Photodetectors

dsDescriptionValue.value: Data for the manuscript 'Colloidally Stable PbS QDs inks Toward Scalable and Efficient Short-wavelength Infrared Photodetectors'. The dataset contains the raw (and processed) data used in the manuscript, including data from UV-Vis, GISAXS measurements and photodetector, solar cell and transistor optoelectronic characterization.

datasetVersion.citation: Wang, Han; Pinna, Jacopo; Garcia Romero, David; Di Mario, Lorenzo; Mehrabi Koushki, Razieh; Portale, Giuseppe; Antonietta Loi, Maria, 2023, "Colloidally Stable PbS QDs inks Toward Scalable and Efficient Short-wavelength Infrared Photodetectors", https://doi.org/10.34894/TIZR10, DataverseNL, V1
